summary: YY Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the unregistered issuance of Class A ordinary shares for services. On August 4, 2026, YYGH issued 304,879 shares to each of two advisors for consulting services (SOP implementation and AI/humanoid robotics), and 237,833 shares to a shareholder of a service provider for renovation services. Shares were valued at US$300,000 (first two) and SGD 300,000 (third), at 80% of average closing price over five days prior. These are routine issuances for services, not a special situation. Immediately after, 7,837,380 Class A shares were outstanding. Issuances were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act.
